# NZBGet restore template
# Apply these values in the NZBGet settings UI after first start.
# This is a settings reference, NOT a complete nzbget.conf: do not copy it over
# the generated config. If editing the generated file manually, stop NZBGet
# first, merge these values into the full config, then start NZBGet again.

Key settings to apply (see README "NZBGet" section for full detail):

  Server1.Name=Eweka
  Server1.Host=news.eweka.nl
  Server1.Port=563
  Server1.Encryption=yes
  Server1.Connections=40
  Server1.Username=<EWEKA_USERNAME>
  Server1.Password=<EWEKA_PASSWORD>

  MainDir=/downloads
  DestDir=${MainDir}/completed
  InterDir=${MainDir}/intermediate
  AppendCategoryDir=no

  Category1.Name=Movies
  Category1.DestDir=${MainDir}/completed/movies
  Category2.Name=Series
  Category2.DestDir=${MainDir}/completed/tv

  ArticleCache=600
  WriteBuffer=2048
  ArticleReadChunkSize=64
  UnrarCmd=unrar
  DirectUnpack=no
  ParRepair=yes
